title: [Audit] Kibana session reconstruction
description: Replay a user’s Kibana session. Filter to one Session to see exactly what that person did; newest first, so sort Time ascending to read it forward. Kibana events only, because sessions are a Kibana concept. Kibana’s internal UI requests, page assets, usage telemetry, the content-management calls that duplicate each object read, and point-in-time internals are left out; public /api/ requests are kept, because an export or import is one. Message is the sentence Kibana wrote for each event.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | WHERE attributes.kibana.session.id IS NOT NULL | WHERE attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time", "saved_object_close_point_in_time") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND (NOT body.text LIKE "*/api/*" OR body.text LIKE "*/api/ui_counters/*" OR body.text LIKE "*/api/content_management/*"))) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, attributes.kibana.session.id, attributes.event.action, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, attributes.kibana.saved_object.name, attributes.kibana.space.id, client.ip, body.text | SORT @timestamp DESC | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, attributes.kibana.session.id AS Session, attributes.event.action AS Action, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type AS `Object type`, attributes.kibana.saved_object.name AS Object, attributes.kibana.space.id AS Space, client.ip AS `Client IP`, body.text AS Message
